items.description: Close wall opening and repaint affected area
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover closing the access opening and repainting the disturbed wall area. Estimate €420 gross for the single combined repair.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge on the building-services invoice. One flat rate at the gross reference level is €81.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers sealing consumables used in the pipe repair. Estimate €24 gross for the invoiced unit.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover the first pipe section on a like-for-like basis. One metre at €45 per metre gives €45 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating the insulation on the repaired pipe. One metre at €24 per metre gives €24 gross.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary installer labour. The invoiced hour at the gross prior rate gives €63.

Section 7.1.7(e) covers necessary investigation, but 7.1.8(b) excludes a separate charge for the contractor's own measuring device. If shown to be a covered third-party charge, estimate €35 gross for one unit.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers technician labour attributable to the repair. The gross prior for the full nine hours is €425.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows only the first travel charge on the same contractor invoice, even if there were separate visits. The conditional gross rate for one charge is €81.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and one equipment deployment charge per operation. Estimate €72 gross for the single unit.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes the contractor's blades as business overhead. The conditional gross estimate for one blade is €15.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers ordinary fittings attributable to the pipe repair. Two fittings at €38 each give €76 gross.

Sections 7.1.8(c) and (d) exclude duplicate or unsupported charges; the invoice does not distinguish this metre from the first. If documented as a distinct installed section, one metre would be €45 gross.

Sections 7.1.8(c) and (d) exclude duplicate or unsupported costs; no separate insulated section is documented beyond the first insulation charge. If separately attributable, one metre would be €24 gross.

Section 7.1.8(c) excludes duplicate labour charges, and this repeated nine-hour entry does not identify distinct work. If shown to represent separate necessary labour under 7.1.7(g), the nine-hour gross prior is €425.
